archetype: Full-Bleed Cinematic Hero (cast as the standing month: a rendered world filling the viewport under centered type)

palette.color_story: cream and graphite with one marigold highlighter

governing_idea: One month on the kitchen wall: every bill stands on its day, the light moves across the counter, and the heads-up arrives before the day does.

speech.h1: Every bill on one calendar. A text before each is due.
headlines: Start with the inbox, because it's the widest door
Then walk the house for paper
Open the apps that bill you without asking
section_names: The heads-up reaches whoever pays it
Pay it where you always have
Add a bill in the time it takes to open the envelope
How Addabill works: Add, See, Heads-up, Tap
Two plans, no fees on your bills
The texts you'd get this month
blog_titles: Your bills live in three places. One evening moves them to one.
The sticky note, the spreadsheet and the reminder app: what each one catches, and what slips past
What a late fee actually costs, and the three days that stop it
speech.opening_about: Somewhere in your house there's a dentist statement.

brief.vibe: A calm kitchen counter in morning light: cream paper, one marigold highlighter, a warm host who is plain about money and never in a hurry.
brief.hero: A rendered month lying on a counter fills the viewport; centered Fraunces H1 in two short sentences sits over it with the purchase button beneath the subhead; the scroll pulls back from one day cell to the whole month.
brief.type: Fraunces (soft, wonky, variable) for headings and oversized numerals with Figtree for body and UI; set piece is the due date 2 settling from a hand circled wonk to sharp as the pull back completes.
brief.palette: Light cream field FAF3E6 with paper white and oat, graphite text, one marigold accent reserved for the purchase button, chips and the today tick, moss for paid checks.
brief.motion: Two easings, Heads-up and Page turn; a loader that flips a date card in step with load then Flips into the hero; a time of day light sweep scrubbed by scroll; tags that lift and resettle at idle; buttons that lift, flatten and breathe.
brief.speech: H1 in two short declaratives (every X on one Y); CTAs 'Purchase the Household plan' and 'Use the Free plan'; sections named as noun phrases and imperatives; a never list; a numbered 01 to 04 how it works; blog titles as comparison, myth negation and what explainer.
brief.rhythm: Full bleed bands (hero, loop video, photo bands, year band) alternating with editorial spreads; Plans as two cards and a real table; blog as a masonry grid; About as alternating spreads.
